nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; controls privileged functions such as nominateNewOwner, setProxy and setTarget.
Pending owner address that must call acceptOwnership to take ownership.
Address of the Proxy contract allowed to call the onlyProxy protected functions of the Proxyable implementation.
Cached original msg.sender passed through by the Proxy; used for authorization of optionalProxy functions.
Implementation (target) contract that the Proxy fallback forwards all calls to via a low-level call.
Attacker-controllable caller address used for ownership checks, proxy checks and forwarding into the target contract.
Sets the initial owner and emits OwnerChanged; reverts on address(0).
onlyOwner function that writes nominatedOwner; ownership transfer step one.
Pulls ownership by requiring msg.sender == nominatedOwner, then sets owner = nominatedOwner and clears the pending owner.
Access-control check that msg.sender equals the stored owner; backs the onlyOwner modifier.
Abstract initializer that stores the proxy address and emits ProxyUpdated.
onlyOwner function that repoints the proxy address used for authorization.
onlyProxy function called by the proxy on every forwarded mutable call to record the real message sender.
Requires that msg.sender is the configured proxy contract.
If the caller is not the proxy and differs from the cached messageSender, overwrites messageSender with msg.sender.
Refreshes messageSender then requires messageSender == owner, enforcing owner-only access through the proxy.
Proxy constructor that delegates owner initialization to Owned.
onlyOwner function that sets the target implementation contract the fallback forwards to.
onlyTarget function that replays target events with inline assembly log0..log4.
Payable fallback that calls target.setMessageSender(msg.sender) and then forwards calldata/value to the target with a low-level call.
Constructor of the ERC20 proxy; only initializes the inherited Proxy.
Staticcall passthrough of name() to the target contract.
Staticcall passthrough of symbol() to the target contract.
Staticcall passthrough of decimals() to the target contract.
Staticcall passthrough of totalSupply() to the target contract.
Staticcall passthrough of balanceOf(account) to the target contract.
Staticcall passthrough of allowance(owner,spender) to the target contract.
Sets messageSender on the target then forwards transfer(to,value); the external call return value is ignored.
Sets messageSender on the target then forwards approve(spender,value); the external call return value is ignored.
Sets messageSender on the target then forwards transferFrom(from,to,value); the external call return value is ignored.
Inline assembly low-level call forwarding gas, calldata and msg.value to the target; attacker-controlled target code re-enters the proxy while state may be inconsistent.
External call Proxyable(target).setMessageSender(msg.sender) executed from the proxy before forwarding a mutable call.
External call IERC20(target).transfer(to,value) whose return value is discarded.
External call IERC20(target).approve(spender,value) whose return value is discarded.
External call IERC20(target).transferFrom(from,to,value) whose return value is discarded.
External staticcall to the target for ERC20 metadata/supply/balance/allowance views.
Inline assembly log0..log4 that emits raw calldata as events on behalf of the target.
Initial owner address passed to the Owned constructor.
Candidate address written into nominatedOwner.
New proxy address written into Proxyable.proxy.
Sender address written into Proxyable.messageSender.
New implementation address written into Proxy.target.
Raw calldata to be emitted as a log entry.
Number of indexed topics (0-4) selecting the log opcode.
Address whose balance is queried from the target.
Token owner address for the allowance query.
Spender address for the allowance query.
Recipient address forwarded to the target transfer call.
Amount forwarded to the target transfer call.
Spender address forwarded to the target approve call.
Amount forwarded to the target approve call.
Source address forwarded to the target transferFrom call.
Destination address forwarded to the target transferFrom call.
Amount forwarded to the target transferFrom call.
Length of the calldata buffer used as the log data size in the _emit assembly block.
